name: Are there specific trends in waterfront property demand between different types of properties, like single-family homes versus condos?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific trends in waterfront property demand between different types of properties, like single-family homes versus condos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, demand trends can differ significantly between single-family waterfront homes and waterfront condos. Single-family homes often appeal to those seeking privacy, land, and direct water access for personal boats, while condos may attract buyers prioritizing amenities, security, and lower maintenance. The choice between these types often involves a practical tradeoff between privacy and space versus convenience and shared facilities, depending on a buyer's lifestyle and financial goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Demand trends vary between single-family homes (privacy/land) and condos (amenities/lower maintenance), reflecting different buyer priorities.
